stem:
A rectangular shaped swimming pool has a paved walkway around it as shown.

[Image: Diagram of a pool and walkway]

What is the area of the paved walkway?
figure_description: A diagram shows an outer shaded rectangle labeled "Walkway" surrounding an unshaded inner rectangle labeled "Pool". The dimensions of the outer rectangle are labeled with double-headed arrows: a length of 70 m along the top and a width of 23 m along the right side. The dimensions of the inner rectangle are also labeled with double-headed arrows: a length of 50 m along its top edge and a width of 18 m along its right edge.
